change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n81, n82, n83, n84, n85 and n86 (all native; none has run). Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `ea71533` (2026-11-19; cycles 7 to 16 found none): diff the registry directories and the catalog slugs, not the commit count; for each new one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-6/ref-shot.ts` in the main checkout shoots a page at 1440x1000 with reduced motion), and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 16 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-16/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools, fill scripts, repair brief, probe and diagnosis prompts are in the same directory). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory, run oxfmt on scenario-info.ts after adding them, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard, list, reach, sweep and full-page 390 frames, the KEYDOWN frame on an IntervalTrack, and the BOX readings of cycle 16's lead tool (`lead-shots.ts` with `shoot-round.sh`). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand a case that scored under 80 its reviewer's findings (SendMessage to the builder's agent id resumes it), at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row or an open Issue already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a note (`notes` in the row's brief, or `factory issue note`) instead of filing a row; a row that closed after the pin cannot take a note, so name it in the cycle file. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md; for hypothesis 1, report the per-case lift of the cases that were repaired beside the median lift, and say when no case was repaired. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 16: (a) check v3-expr-16-kit-fixes before round 0 on a build of the pinned master, with the cycle-16 scenarios: n77 and n78 round 0's 390 frames from `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-16/src-r0/n77` and `n78` (the `phone: 'columns'` headers 'Landed' and 'Failed' whole; the `StatGroup` error causes and the backlog pill's 'vs prior 30 d' whole; even heat ticks at 1800 and 390), n75 and n76 (the unfocused bars recede on focus; the SWEEP counters above 0; no guide across '4 · 3.4%'), n76 at 390 under `?fixture=spike` (values kept and apart) and under `?fixture=finished` at 1800 (no band between the right-hand cards), n79 under `?fixture=surge` at 390 (end labels with leaders, none struck), n78 round 0 and n80 at 390 (the keys keep the chart in view), n80 at 1800 and 390 (the x chip off every tick; n80 gone from apps/playground/src/cycle/expression-16/known.ts and the full quality matrix green); and the older gaps: n70's '100 %' at 390 and its ledger at 1800, n71's inset and 'Not counted', n72 at 390, n73 round 0's error frame at 390, n74's end labels and `?fixture=runaway`, n52's SWEEP at 390, n57's focused cell, n61's list frame and phone-card id, n64's '92', n67's caret at 390 and chip at 1800, n68's caption. If any did not land, tell builders so the same gap does not cost twice; (b) check v3-expr-16-skill and tell nothing of it to builders beyond what ships; count the builders whose read-aloud pass names a repeat and cuts it rather than keeping it, and whether X1 still loses a point on 5 of 6 (cycle 16: 5 of 6;
